newsitem.title: USA: Birmingham, Ala., mayor urges $60 mln school bonds.
newsitem.headline: Birmingham, Ala., mayor urges $60 mln school bonds.

text.p: Birmingham Mayor Richard Arrington has proposed a $60 million bond issue for improvements in the city school district, the Birmingham Post-Herald reported.
The proposal is contingent on persuading the school board to adopt a controversial plan to close up to 13 district schools, the newspaper said.
Arrington said the district has too many schools to operate efficiently -- 79 schools to serve 40,000 students, compared with Jefferson County's 63 schools for 40,000 students.

The Birmingham district has estimated it needs at least $225 million of construction and renovation. It has about $28.5 million of authorized but unissued bond capacity from previous referendums, and drafted a list of capital improvement projects last week to use that money.
